comment: Machine answer key for the delta eval (run 3). 'delta' per row is mode-keyed: seeded mode plants the golden run-2 state so all four delta classes are reachable; live mode runs a real phase-1 baseline first, where REGRESSED and the quarantine-expiry event are unreachable and score n/a.

rows.note: Added 2026-09-07 with 0.84.0 (H-2): a NEW finding carries `filed_at` only when it was written as findings/<ID>.json — proven and filed in the moment, not composed at the end. n/a on a state an older harness measured.
